algorithms: What does BFS level i mean about the number of edges from the start?
广度优先搜索中第 i 层的顶点与起点相隔多少条边？
Level i means reachable in i edges but not fewer.

有向图的邻接表为每个顶点存储什么？

What time bound includes discovering unreachable vertices in BFS?
BFS 连同列出不可达顶点一起计算时，时间复杂度是多少？

How do parent pointers recover a shortest BFS path?
用 BFS 的父指针怎样恢复从目标回到起点的最短路径？

What search behavior is compared to exploring a maze?
哪种图搜索会走到受阻处再沿痕迹回溯探索新邻居？

How is a DFS back edge different from a forward edge?
DFS 中返回祖先和指向后代的非树边分别叫什么？

Why does reversing DFS finishing order give a topological order?
为什么拓扑排序使用 DFS 完成时间的逆序？

Is a cross edge by itself the cycle certificate taught here?

What edge-weight assumption does Dijkstra require?
Dijkstra 对每条边的权重有什么前提？

Which unsettled vertex does the greedy shortest-path algorithm choose?
贪心最短路算法每次从未确定顶点中挑选哪个？

How does the array priority queue affect Dijkstra complexity?
Dijkstra 使用数组实现优先队列时，总时间复杂度是什么？

Does the DAG shortest-path procedure need the same nonnegative-edge restriction?
DAG 最短路是否也必须禁止负权边，为什么没有负环？

投影到非零向量张成的一条直线，其投影矩阵秩是多少？

Why does applying a projection matrix twice have the same effect as once?
为什么投影矩阵作用两次与一次相同？

What transpose property does an orthogonal projection matrix have?
正交投影矩阵的转置有什么性质？

What do least squares minimize when Ax=b has no exact solution?
Ax=b 无精确解时，最小二乘优化什么量？

Which projection gives the residual rather than the fitted component?
如果 P 给出拟合投影，哪个矩阵给出垂直方向的残差？
I-P projects to the perpendicular subspace.
How are the fitted and residual components related to the original vector?
最小二乘几何解释中，投影部分和误差部分与原向量有什么关系？
Projection plus error equals b.
Does least squares require the original right-hand side to already lie in the column space?
最小二乘是否要求 b 本来就在列空间内，精确解对应什么特殊情况？
Zero residual is the special case b in column space; otherwise minimize length.
What two conditions define an orthonormal basis?
标准正交基的向量满足哪两个条件？
Pairwise perpendicular, each unit length.
What does Q transpose Q become for orthonormal columns even if Q is rectangular?
即使 Q 不是方阵，标准正交列为何使 Q 转置乘 Q 等于单位矩阵？
Column inner products form identity.
What must be removed from the second vector in Gram-Schmidt?
Gram-Schmidt 怎样从第二个原始向量得到与第一个垂直的方向？
Subtract its projection onto the first vector.
What kind of input vectors does Gram-Schmidt start with?
Gram-Schmidt 在这里从什么性质的原始向量开始构造标准正交向量？
Starts with independent vectors.
calculus: What is the geometric formula for a dot product?
点积怎样用两向量长度和夹角表达？
Product of lengths times cosine.
Why is the dot product of a vector with itself its squared length?
为什么向量与自身的点积等于长度平方？
The angle is zero and cosine is one.
How is a three-component vector length computed?
三维向量怎样用各分量求长度？
Square root of sum of squared components.
What does orthogonality mean geometrically?
orthogonality 在几何中是什么意思？
It means perpendicularity.
What does the sign of a planar determinant tell us in an area computation?
二维行列式用来算平行四边形面积时，符号与方向有什么关系？
Determinant is signed area, sign depends on orientation.
How does dotting with a unit vector obtain a directional component?
如何用单位方向向量的点积得到某方向上的分量？
Dot with the unit direction.
Which hand gives the direction of A cross B?
A 叉乘 B 的方向用哪只手和什么动作判断？
Right hand points along A, curls toward B, thumb gives direction.
How does a three-dimensional determinant relate to volume?
三维行列式在这里为什么能用于体积计算？
Signed volume; changing orientation changes sign.
What changes when the order of a cross product is reversed?
交换叉乘中 A 与 B 的顺序，方向会发生什么变化？
Cross product order matters; opposite direction.
What output shape results from a 3x4 matrix times a 4x2 matrix?
3×4 矩阵乘 4×2 矩阵的结果是什么形状？

What operation transposes a matrix?
矩阵转置怎样交换行和列？
Read rows as columns and vice versa.
Is the identity matrix the same transformation as the zero matrix?
单位矩阵与零矩阵是相同的变换吗？
Identity preserves X; zero sends X to zero.
probability: What two requirements should the list of outcomes in a sample space satisfy?
样本空间中的结果列表应满足哪两项要求？
Mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive.
What is an event in the probability model?
概率模型中的事件与样本空间有什么关系？
An event is a subset of the sample space.
How does a finite discrete uniform law compute an event probability?
有限离散均匀模型如何用计数算事件概率？
Count outcomes in A divided by total outcomes.
What extra additivity condition is used for countably many disjoint events?
可数无限个互斥事件的并集概率，需要什么可加性条件？
Countable additivity.
What becomes the new universe when conditioning on event B?
给定事件 B 后，条件概率把什么作为新的范围？
B is the new universe.
What probabilities does Bayes rule infer from likelihoods?
贝叶斯规则怎样从似然和先验转为观察 B 之后的信念？

Which partitioning approach underlies the total probability theorem?
全概率公式怎样利用对样本空间的划分？
Divide and conquer over a partition with conditional probabilities.
Why is conditioning on a zero-probability event undefined in this definition?
在这里的定义中，为什么零概率事件不能作为条件？

How is independence expressed as no information about another event?
事件独立性怎样用一个事件不提供另一个事件的信息来解释？
Occurrence of A provides no information about B.
Must independent events remain independent after conditioning?
原来独立的事件在给定额外条件后必然还独立吗？
Conditioning may affect independence.
Does pairwise independence alone establish independence of a collection?
两两独立就能推出一组事件相互独立吗？

What information condition characterizes an independent collection of events?
相互独立的一组事件，对观察其中某些事件有什么信息限制？

economics: What choice principle is the building block of consumer behavior?
本讲用什么选择原则作为消费者行为的基础？
Utility maximization.

Prefer x to z.
What is marginal utility in calculus terms?
边际效用用微积分语言是什么？

讲者后来是否纠正了“完备性不允许无差异”的说法？

Where are the intercepts of a two-good budget line?
两种商品预算线的截距由收入和各自价格怎样决定？

What condition identifies the best affordable bundle graphically?
图形上怎样找预算约束内最好的消费组合？

What does the slope of the budget constraint represent?
预算线斜率代表哪两个价格的相对关系？

Why can an ordinal utility transformation leave choices unchanged?
为什么效用只表示顺序时，去掉例子中的平方根可能不改变选择？
In this example ordinal transformation does not change choice.
What distinguishes normal and inferior goods by income elasticity?
收入弹性的符号怎样区分正常品和劣等品？
Positive for normal, negative for inferior.
What does the substitution effect hold constant?
替代效应在价格变化时保持什么不变？
Hold utility constant.
What is held fixed when defining the income effect here?
这里定义收入效应时，改变收入并保持什么不变？
Hold prices constant.
Why might restricted food stamps provide less utility than cash?
为什么限制用途的食品券可能比等额现金给消费者带来更低效用？
Restriction may force a lower indifference curve; paternalism is stated reason.
quantum: What can quantum mechanics predict when experiment outcomes are not deterministic?
当实验结果不能被确定预测时，量子力学仍能预测什么？
Probabilities of outcomes.
What is the meaning of superposing two solutions of a linear equation?
在线性方程中，把两个解叠加的含义是什么？
A linear combination of solutions is another solution.
How can a light beam gain energy without changing color?
光束保持颜色不变时，怎样增加其总能量？
More photons, same photon frequency/energy.
Do two photons need to interfere with each other in the one-at-a-time experiment?
逐个发送光子的干涉实验，需要两个光子彼此干涉吗？

干涉仪状态的两个复数分量分别编码什么？

What does a phase shifter do to a probability amplitude?
相移器怎样改变光子的概率幅？

Which detector can identify a functioning bomb without its explosion?

固定频率时，提高光强为何增加光电流却不增加光电子能量？

Which momentum belongs in the de Broglie wavelength rather than mc?
德布罗意波长使用真实动量还是 mc，这与康普顿波长有何区别？

When is the classical approximation appropriate relative to obstacle size?
相对障碍物尺度，德布罗意波长多小时可以忽略波动效应？
